name: shiny
description: Every Shiny library for .NET in one plugin — cross-platform mobile client libraries (Bluetooth LE client & peripheral hosting, GPS tracking, geofencing, background jobs, local & push notifications, HTTP background transfers, bidirectional JSON data sync, OBD-II diagnostics, music library, health data, contacts, calendar, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, AI conversation, embedded HTTP server, core hosting/DI), .NET MAUI components (Shell navigation with source-generated routes), shared MAUI & Blazor UI controls (TableView, FloatingPanel, ChatView, ImageViewer/ImageEditor, scheduler, Markdown, barcodes, and more), Mediator/CQRS with middleware and source generators, AOT-friendly data libraries (DocumentDb schema-free JSON store, Spatial geospatial database, Firestore), .NET Aspire integrations (Orleans ADO.NET hosting, Gluetun VPN routing, tunnelling), and source generators & utilities (attribute-driven DI, key/value stores, .resx localization generator, modular MAUI/ASP.NET Core hosting, server-side push dispatch)
